name: claude-remote-computer
description: Desktop and RDP control for Claude Code — see the screen, move the mouse, type, and reach remote servers that only expose port 3389.

plugins.name: claude-remote-computer
plugins.description: Let Claude Code drive your Windows desktop — screenshot, look, then click and type. Unlike browser-only automation, this reaches PowerShell, File Explorer, installers, IIS Manager, legacy GUI apps, and remote servers over RDP. Pure ctypes + Pillow: nothing to install beyond Pillow, no admin rights, no extension. Ships a focus guard that refuses to send input when the target window is not in front, so keystrokes never leak into the wrong app.
